reason: Bridges image messages to a configured vision model, replacing image blocks in main-model requests with text descriptions while preserving the original image display in chat.

summaries.zh: 将聊天中的图片交给配置的视觉模型生成文字描述，并把描述提供给主模型，同时保留聊天记录中的原图显示。
summaries.en: Sends chat images to a configured vision model for text descriptions, provides those descriptions to the main model, and preserves the original images in chat history.

capabilities: Sends image content to a configured vision-model provider for analysis
Rewrites image blocks in outbound language-model requests as generated text descriptions
Caches generated descriptions in process memory
Uses a configured API route and existing API key environment variable
